## PILLAR #1: The Pricing Architecture System  

The Problem: Most medspas under-price laser treatments or use flat pricing that leaves money on the table. The Solution: Strategic tiered pricing with value anchoring.  

The Pricing Psychology Framework

TIER 1: Single Session  
Price: $450  
Position: "Try it" option  
Profit margin: 30%  
Marketing message: "Perfect if you're new to laser"  

TIER 2: Package (6 sessions)  
Price: $2,100 ($350/session) - 22% discount  
Position: "Best value" (ANCHOR THIS)  
Profit margin: 45%  
Marketing message: "Most popular - complete treatment series"  

TIER 3: VIP Unlimited (12 months)  
Price: $2,700 (unlimited sessions for 12 months)  
Position: "Peace of mind" option  
Profit margin: 60%+ if client uses < 9 sessions  
Marketing message: "Guaranteed results with unlimited touch-ups"  

RESULT:  
- 70% of clients choose Tier 2 (package)  
- 20% choose Tier 3 (highest profit)  
- 10% choose Tier 1 (still profitable)  
- Average client value: $2,220 vs $450 for single sessions

## PILLAR #2: The Utilization Maximization System  

Goal: Get your laser from 30% utilization to 65%+ within 90 days.

The 5 Utilization Strategies:  

STRATEGY #1: The Off-Peak Incentive  
Problem: Laser sits idle Monday mornings, Friday afternoons Solution: Dynamic pricing for off-peak slots  

Monday-Wednesday before 11am:  
- "Early Bird Special": 20% off single treatments

Friday 3pm-close:

RESULT:  
- 10-13 additional treatments per week  
- Even at 20% discount, it's profitable (would have been $0) - Monthly revenue increase: $12,000-18,000  

STRATEGY #2: The Back-to-Back Efficiency Protocol

BEFORE:

RESULT:  
- 2 additional treatments per day  
- 10 additional treatments per week  
- Monthly increase: 40 treatments × $350 average = $14,000 - No additional cost

- Additional monthly revenue: $22,000+  

TRAINING TIMELINE:

- Week 2-3: Hands-on practice (on each other/models) - Week 4: Supervised client treatments

Problem: Empty slots that could be filled with referrals

## PILLAR #3: The Treatment Menu Engineering System Goal: Design a treatment menu that maximizes revenue per laser hour.  

The Profit Per Hour Analysis

## PILLAR #4: The Staff Mastery & Confidence System  

The Problem: Providers aren't fully confident, leading to slow treatments, hesitant selling, and poor results. The Solution: Systematic training that builds expertise AND confidence.

Week 1-2: Foundation Intensive

- Device physics and safety (2 hours)  
- Skin type assessment protocol (1 hour)  
- Parameter selection matrix (2 hours)  
- Hands-on practice on models (4 hours)  
- Treatment protocol memorization (1 hour)  

CONFIDENCE TRAINING:  
- Common client concerns and objections (1 hour) - Treatment expectation setting (30 min)  
- Before/after photography protocol (30 min)  
- Complication recognition and management (1 hour)  

CERTIFICATION:  
- Written exam: 90%+ to pass  
- Practical exam: Perform 3 supervised treatments to standard - Sign off by lead provider or medical director  

DELIVERABLE:  
- Each provider has laminated protocol cards  
- Quick reference guide at each laser  
- Emergency contact list posted  

Week 3-4: Consultation Mastery

Minutes 13-15: Pricing & Closing  
- Present three-tier pricing  
- Emphasize "most popular" package  
- Handle objections  
- Book first appointment
